selection_rule: Run every declared seed/side/checkpoint/candidate, unchanged. Per checkpoint: no regression in elimination wins, losses/caps, own deaths or ticks on common wins; require a strict quality improvement. If the set ties or is mixed, do not claim superiority or keep expanding samples to force a pass.
rationale: The initial fresh holdout is tied and does not exercise the conditional fix. This single, finite confirmation batch broadens coverage without tuning. It is disclosed as a follow-up after observing a tie, not an untouched original test set or formal significance test.
safety: No cloud, model retry, warmup, source/weight change or user-match interruption. Candidate uses cycle05's pinned source snapshot.
